convention: Flagged, not silently corrected. Every status says what was measured, what was not, and what the consequence is.

irregularities.finding: Upstream C2 stepover-relay P1 +0.000405 (3/4 folds positive) is withdrawn because the earlier candidate/base construction and Qfaults vectors saw full-catalogue/held-out source geometry. The corrected source-exclusion diagnostic has mean P1 ΔDTI −0.000722 (0/4 positive); across folds 2,643 added dots yielded zero incremental TPw and 2,643 incremental FPw. P2 SGMC proxy ΔDTI is +0.000283, but this cannot override P1. The corrected run remains conditional: fixed H19-5 was not re-derived per fold, this was not an independent preregistered confirmation, and the community Qfaults mirror is not authenticated to the current official archive.
irregularities.consequence: C2 remains a research artifact only and is not linked as a download recommendation. No P1/P2 result is a DrivenData score or private-label validation; the corrected diagnostic does not clear a submission slot.

irregularities.finding: The owner-mirrored sample_submission.tif is not a blank/absence raster: within its 5,167,373 finite cells it has value 1.0 at exactly the 60,988 positive cells of labels.tif and 0.0 elsewhere; 7,111,787 cells are NaN outside the finite mask.
irregularities.evidence: Local comparison of hash-pinned data/sample_submission.tif and data/labels.tif; sample mirror SHA-256 2176d08e485aa2cd2860ce8df539db4faf4d76163b38a4dd8c30a40454d35cbc.
irregularities.consequence: Used only for CRS, geotransform, dimensions and finite footprint. Never treated as truth or a prediction template with target labels. This may indicate the owner mirror is mislabeled or misassembled; the organizer file was not independently downloaded.

irregularities.finding: The template mask has 5,167,373 finite cells. In the owner-mirrored training raster, 3,061 of those cells carry the float32 nodata sentinel in each of 18 bands; band 6 (tc) has 12 additional sentinel cells (3,073 total). These counts were measured by reading the raw float32 band bytes and intersecting with the template footprint. The earlier 1,521-cell claim was incorrect because it compared whole-raster valid counts from grids with different masks.
irregularities.evidence: Reproducible per-band counts in evidence/input_grid_audit.json, generated by scripts/audit_inputs.py from the 17 hash-verified owner-mirror inputs.
irregularities.consequence: Any model writing raw nodata sentinels as probabilities can trigger the portal's [0,1] error. The reference TIFF is re-written from a source raster that already contains only 0/1/NaN and is validated on disk. This does not prove it will pass the organizer's portal.

irregularities.finding: All 17 competition/external inputs restored in this checkout come from owner-published GitHub mirrors with matching SHA-256 pins. No DrivenData-authenticated download receipt is available.
irregularities.evidence: registry/owner_mirror_input_pins.json; evidence/restore_log.txt; evidence/input_grid_audit.json. The provenance warning says owner mirror, not organizer-authenticated.
irregularities.consequence: Every local data result is conditional on owner-mirror bytes. A SHA-256 match proves equality to that mirror, not origin, license, official schema, or portal acceptance.

irregularities.finding: The first-pass evaluation sampled pseudo-hidden truth pixels from the known catalogue and then called reconstruct_shadow(emission, hidden), which adds predictions at the sampled hidden truth locations whenever existing emission lies within the selected radius. The prediction therefore used held-out truth coordinates. The radius was swept against owner-reported live scores and then used as a scoring parameter.
irregularities.consequence: All first-pass DTI gains and '15/16 cells' statements are withdrawn. They are not a valid holdout or evidence for submission-slot promotion. Experimental TIFFs were removed from docs/downloads.

irregularities.finding: Seeds 0 and 1 used in the so-called confirmation were also used in exploratory pruning selection, and the 10% trim was selected after a 40k/35k/30k budget sweep. The number of fold x seed cells is not an independent sample count when spatial folds and tuning are reused.
irregularities.consequence: No first-pass confirmation result is treated as preregistered independent evidence.

irregularities.finding: The pseudo-truth was sampled from the catalogue, while H27/H36/H38 remove dots near the visible catalogue. That construction is structurally biased against those catalogue-flank-pruned artifacts. A first-pass loss against D2.8 cannot refute H36/H38; a within-family prune win cannot validate transfer to private faults.
irregularities.consequence: No cross-family ranking is reported. A valid comparison needs held-out whole fault systems, predictions generated without their geometry, a matched budget, and an independent source-label validation.

irregularities.status: first-pass domain result withdrawn; analog source pending
irregularities.finding: The first-pass 'source/target' regions were upper/lower quantiles of GDR well/spring record density, not Dixie Valley, Desert Peak or Brady field-specific domains. The 27,092 CSV rows contain only 12,570 unique 100-m cells, so row counts include repeated tables for one site. The discriminator used a random row split on spatially correlated raster features; its HGB class was not shown to equal HΔH for the fault model; no finite-sample VC term or lambda (joint-label error) was supplied.
irregularities.evidence: archive/withdrawn_first_pass/evidence/domain_adaptation.json; archive/withdrawn_first_pass/evidence/domain_log.txt; current fail-closed replacement scripts/run_domain_adaptation.py; Springer paper https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s10994-009-5152-4.
irregularities.consequence: The archived AUC=1.0 is not a valid Ben-David divergence estimate and neither licenses nor refutes the requested analog transfer. A field-specific source label set and spatially blocked domain test are still required.

irregularities.finding: The original first-pass run_domain_adaptation.py source was overwritten by a fail-closed replacement before an archival copy was made. The result JSON and execution log are preserved, and the defects are documented, but the exact prior runner source is not in this repository.
irregularities.consequence: Do not describe the archive as byte-complete. Historical code-level reconstruction is limited to the preserved outputs and review notes; the old result remains withdrawn regardless.

irregularities.finding: First-pass code formed K/Th, U/K and K*U/Th from owner-mirror uint8 radiometric bands without their per-band quantisation/offset metadata. Those values are not demonstrated to be physical ratios. The hand-coded AUC also mixed zero-based and one-based tie ranks; replaced with sklearn roc_auc_score.
irregularities.evidence: archive/withdrawn_first_pass/scripts/channel_screen_unreviewed.py and archive/withdrawn_first_pass/evidence/channel_screen_unverified.json; corrected exploratory implementation is scripts/channel_screen.py.
irregularities.consequence: No 'below chance' or 'best channel' claim from the first-pass radiometric screen is a scientific result. Any future radiometric test must use official physical-value products or verified precomputed ratio layers and a target-relevant, independently held-out label set.

irregularities.finding: The previous active score registry inverted owner-reported DTI values and emission sizes into an inferred hidden-truth size and local score calibration. The score/file identities are not authenticated, the hidden-truth population was unobserved, and the calibration depended on the invalid truth-conditioned reconstruction instrument.
irregularities.evidence: archive/withdrawn_first_pass/evidence/live_scores_inversion_withdrawn.json; archive/withdrawn_first_pass/evidence/instrument_calibration.json; registry/live_scores.json now records reports without an inversion.
irregularities.consequence: The prior inferred hidden-truth size, marginal-gain operating point and reconstructed DTI scale are not current estimates and must not be used for candidate selection or leaderboard prediction.

irregularities.status: frozen screen failed; stopped, not slot-cleared
irregularities.finding: The preregistered cross-physics edge-normal candidate reallocated 5% of H27-4 dots at matched count. Four fold deltas were −0.004907, −0.012736, +0.003241, +0.003454 (mean −0.002737; 2/4 positive). P2 SGMC delta was +0.000159. It beat the matched-random mean but failed the baseline P1 mean and strict-majority gates. The first full run wrote complete JSON evidence but then raised a non-scientific ValueError while printing a relative output path; the path-display bug was fixed without rerunning/altering results.
irregularities.consequence: Stop H33-6 for this round. Do not tune or spend a submission slot. P1/P2 are catalogue/SGMC proxy diagnostics, not private-label or competition scores. Fixed H19-5 was not re-derived per fold, so even a numeric pass would have remained conditional.
